answer: Here is one mechanism that works: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because mirror only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, plume is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
